title: XCgui+
description: Replace the original gui with a dark and transparent one
body:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCgui+

✨ Core Features
🎨 Deep Aesthetics: The entire interface uses a dark transparent design, reducing visual fatigue from high-brightness UI.

🪟 Transparent Layers: Menus, inventory, and crafting interfaces are all transparent, revealing the background world.

🌙 Dark Mode Optimization: Designed specifically for night gaming and modern displays, comfortable for the eyes.

⚡ Exclusive to Higher Versions: Perfectly adapts to new UI elements in version 1.21.11, solving the scarcity of transparent materials in higher versions.

🛠️ Installation Instructions
1. Download the latest .zip file.
2. No need to unzip, just place it into the .minecraft/resourcepacks/ folder.
3. Select and activate the resource pack in the game.
4. Recommended to use a shader pack for the best transparency effect.

🎨 Design Concept
"Transparent UI materials have been scarce in higher versions of Minecraft. This resource pack aims to fill that gap, providing players with a modern, comfortable, and aesthetically pleasing interface experience, especially suitable for long gaming sessions and building projects."

📁 Contents
✅ Complete GUI texture overhaul

✅ Adaptation for new version-exclusive UI elements

✅ Custom main menu background (optional)

✅ Accompanying loading screen and button sound effects

⚠️ Notes
It is recommended to use with a shader pack for the best transparency effects.

Adjust in-game brightness settings when using for the first time.

🔮 Future Plans
More transparency level options

Extended textures for blocks/entities

Shader pack specific optimizations

Interactive configuration interface
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCgui+ 烧仙草GUI+

✨ 核心特色
🎨 深邃美学：全界面采用深色透明设计，减少高亮度UI的视觉疲劳

🪟 透明层次感：菜单、背包、合成界面均透明，透出背景世界

🌙 暗色模式优化：专为夜间游戏和现代显示设备设计，护眼舒适

⚡ 高版本独有：完美适配1.21.11新UI元素，解决高版本透明材质稀缺问题

🛠️ 安装说明
text
1. 下载最新的 .zip 文件
2. 无需解压，放入 .minecraft/resourcepacks/ 文件夹
3. 在游戏中选择并激活材质包
4. 推荐搭配光影包获得最佳透明效果

🎨 设计理念
“在高版本Minecraft中，透明UI材质一直较为稀缺。本材质包旨在填补这一空白，为玩家提供现代、舒适且美观的界面体验，特别适合长时间游戏和建筑创作。”

📁 包含内容
✅ GUI纹理全面重制

✅ 新版本独有UI元素适配

✅ 自定义主菜单背景（可选）

✅ 配套加载屏幕和按钮音效

⚠️ 注意事项
建议配合光影使用以获得最佳透明效果

首次使用建议调整游戏亮度设置

🔮 未来计划
更多透明度等级选项

配套实体/方块材质扩展

光影包专项优化

可交互配置界面
